title: docs(skills): objectstack-formula says an unlowerable SharingRule condition fails the build and the rule is skipped at runtime
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91tYCagMT6JaQ6YA5YqnWwi)_

Fixes #36516

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用公式技能包写共享规则的 AI 和开发者,以前被告知「条件算不出来会让写入失败」,现在读到的是真实情况:这样的共享规则在构建时就报错,运行时整条规则被跳过、不授予任何访问权,只留一行警告日志。
- 为什么做:这是公式技能包教错失效方式的一处文字;权限规则教错,AI 会按错误的预期去设计和排查共享。
- 出错会怎样:只改了技能包里的一句说明和两处重复文字,不改任何运行行为;如果新句子有误,读者会被教错,撤回这一个改动即可恢复原文。
- 要你做什么:批准这一处受管技能包文字改动。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, section "Surfaces that take an Expression", the fault-open warning paragraph. The sentence used to say an unevaluable `Hook` / `SharingRule` `condition` or validation predicate aborts the write. It now reads:

> an unevaluable `Hook` `condition` or validation predicate **aborts the write** (§5); a `SharingRule` `condition` that does not lower to a filter fails the build, and at runtime the rule is skipped and grants nothing (one WARN).

Only the `SharingRule` half changed. The `Hook` and validation-predicate halves say what they said before.

What the code does, read at `main` d463c46f:

- Build: `packages/lint/src/validate-sharing-rule-enforceability.ts:18-28` and its "Why `error`" section: a condition that does not lower is reported as an `error`.
- Runtime: `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/declared-sharing-rules.ts:154` compiles the condition with `compileCelToFilter` and no variables; `:217` turns a refusal into a `condition` skip; `:370-374` calls `warnOnce` and `continue`s, so the rule never enters the served set; `:336-348` logs one WARN per rule and cause. A sharing rule's condition is never evaluated on a write, so there is no write to abort.

No eval case is added: case 14 in `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` already expects "the rule would grant nothing" for a condition that does not lower.

### Token budget: paid by two cuts, ceiling not raised

The corrected sentence costs +127 bytes. Two restatements in the same file are cut to pay for it:

| Cut | Bytes | Where the content still lives in the file |
|:---|---:|:---|
| The note under the translation table: `previous.x` fails the write on an insert unless guarded by `previous != null &&` | -105 | Section 5: the `previous` table's "Insert events" row (`previous` is `null`, the two guard spellings, a column read off it faults) and the "An unevaluable condition ABORTS the operation" paragraph (a column read off `previous` on an insert fails the write) |
| "Two more dialects ride the same envelope." at the head of "Cron and template surfaces" (the next sentence now starts "Neither dialect is CEL") | -34 | "Core contract": "Every expression in metadata is the same envelope" and the three-dialect table listing `cron` and `template` |

Readings (the ratchet prices `ceil((bytes - 20) / 4)`; the 20 is the release-stamp line):

| | Before (`main` d463c46f) | After (f768c921) |
|:---|---:|---:|
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` lines | 493 | 491 |
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` bytes | 24048 | 24036 |
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` tokens (ceiling 6008) | 6007 | 6004 |
| All `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines | 4951 | 4949 |
| All `skills/*/SKILL.md` bytes | 261175 | 261163 |
| Ratcheted authored bundle tokens (ceiling sum 202541) | 197573 | 197570 |

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not edited; the formula row's ceiling stays 6008.

## Tests

Text-only change to a published skill; no code, no test file. No ablation (no tested behaviour changed). All readings at f768c921.

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, "skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md is 6004 tokens (ceiling 6008; headroom 4)", "60 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`: exit 0, "Skill docs in sync".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` (after building the lint closure under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0): "26 record-scoped formula example(s) across 593 files / 1864 TS blocks judged clean".

## Acceptance notes

- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 49 families; `--ran` answers "49 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 45 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED (4 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". The four are `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`: each refuses without a full `pnpm build`, which this text-only diff does not owe locally. NOT MEASURED locally; CI reads them.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` at f768c921: "VERDICT clean exit 0" (one open PR shares the file and merges cleanly).
- The first cut removes a reminder that sat next to the `ISCHANGED(x)` row. Its content is intact in section 5, which the cheat-sheet's "Previous record" row already points to.

## Verification

- Read first: `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` (the changed sentence near line 447, then the two cuts), then `.changeset/36516-formula-skill-sharing-rule-skip.md`.
- Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and read the `objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` line: 6004 tokens, ceiling 6008.
